name: OPS_CONTROLS_TOGGLES_20261025
comment: ANCHOR: OPS_CONTROLS_TOGGLES_20261025 — Ops -> Controls toggles (operator 2026-10-25 "this should have just been a toggle to turn on/off on the control ops."): ENABLE_SMS, OPERATOR_SMS_EMAIL (10 digits @ known carrier gateway) and COMMS_GATEWAY_MODE (OFF/CANARY/ACTIVE) as operator_settings catalog entries (risky: passkey + phrase, host applier), projected to a non-secret env file the consumers read (projection > environment > default; restore on unset); test-send is operator-only, confirm-gated, idempotent, cooldown-limited and audited; overlay env reads are literal managed names only. Hermetic: in-memory store, temp projection, fake transport.
